parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, border, facility or care restriction is documented for visitors. X/indeterminate markers, gender-identity-inclusive anti-discrimination protection for goods and services in all states, hate-crime aggravation and a police bias-duty give operative protections. A 2025 neo-Nazi dating-app ambush network is a documented organised threat, but sources identify gay/bisexual men, not trans visitors, and the state arrested 15 suspects; trans-specific magnitude is unresolved. Detention housing rules exist but are not summarised, an open question rather than a documented exposure. Far-right electoral strength is climate risk, not an operative visitor restriction.

entry_documents.exposure: Not documented. No visitor marker mismatch, refusal or secondary inspection regime documented.
entry_documents.protection: X/indeterminate/no marker available domestically and legal gender change possible without mandatory medical procedures; foreign documents not documented as rejected.
entry_documents.interaction: Domestic marker recognition is a climate signal; no documented border interaction for foreign passports.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Not documented in usable detail; justice ministry rules on housing trans people in prisons are cited but not summarised.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: 2025 national report states detention framework includes gender self-determination and anti-discrimination protection.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: If detained, unknown placement rules could compound any other encounter, but no documented birth-sex placement or abuse is in the dossier.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented. No bathroom, sauna, ward or other facility ban for visitors documented; a rejected queer sauna-time petition is not a general access ban.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Anti-discrimination protection for goods and services extended to every state by January 2017, covering gender identity via recent amendments.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Uniform national/state coverage means no subnational facility regime documented as divergent.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors. Psychiatric-opinion conditions for resident name/gender change and insurance-funded treatment are resident-facing only.
care_services.protection: No documented visitor care denial; healthcare rules applicable to visitors are not documented.
care_services.interaction: Resident insurance conditions do not transfer to a visitor's home-country medication or care.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific criminal offence or state threat-framing documented. Same-sex conduct decriminalised 1971; marriage and adoption equal.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Hate speech on sexual orientation banned from 2016 with aggravation; Security Police Act obliges police to avoid perceived bias; Equal Treatment Act broadened to gender identity/expression.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Far-right party strength and historic opposition are political climate, not an operative visitor law, and the hostile-network arrests show enforcement against attackers.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No visitor-facing restriction on travelling with a minor, parental recognition, or family travel documented.
minors_guardians.protection: Marriage/adoption framework is open to same-sex couples; no documented barrier for a trans parent/guardian visitor.
minors_guardians.interaction: Resident bans/resolutions on conversion therapy and blockers endorsement do not document a traveller-facing minor exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented organised 2025 neo-Nazi network used fake dating profiles to lure at least 17 LGBTQ people to filmed ambushes, 15 arrested; sources identify victims as gay/bisexual men, trans inclusion unresolved. 6,751 suspected hate crimes/1,575 prejudice-violence victims in 2025, not broken down by trans status, transphobic incidents reported declined without figures.
street_violence_police_response.protection: State law-enforcement arrested 15 suspects in March 2025; police bias-duty and hate-crime aggravation provide recourse framework.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Pattern shows real street/app risk in the general LGBTQ sphere, but documented targeting and trans-specific rate are not established; arrest response mitigates impunity inference.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Detention housing provisions not summarised; trans-specific hate-crime magnitude and whether trans people were in ambush network are unresolved; under-recording acknowledged.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Anti-discrimination law, hate-crime aggravation and police bias-duty document formal recourse; no documented remedy failure for visitors.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unknowns are open questions, not documented exposures, and do not outweigh documented acceptance/protections, but prevent a near-perfect score.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar or slightly lower: both have explicit equality protections, X recognition and functioning complaints framework with residual friction. This case has an additional organised ambush network and unresolved detention rules, but no documented visitor detention or facility ban, so it sits just below 0.85 rather than materially lower.

Higher than 0.75-C: that anchor has brief detention/discretion at crossings despite protections. Here no visitor detention, document-fraud or border discretion is documented at all, and goods/services protection is nationwide, so exposure is lower.

Higher than 0.65-D: that anchor involves detention at a protest with discriminatory enforcement, albeit dismissed promptly. Here no comparable documented police detention of a trans visitor or protester exists; the documented organised violence was prosecuted by arrest.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: nationwide anti-discrimination and marker recognition plus no documented visitor-facing restriction form the operative system; state/province variation is sequencing only. The main exposure is ambient organised anti-LGBTQ ambush violence, not trans-specific on current sources, with arrests as a protective response. Unsummarised prison-housing rules and unbroken-down hate-crime data are uncertainties, not proven exposures. Far-right political strength is a trajectory risk without an operative hostile rule. Together this is low but not negligible risk for an outed visitor, adult alone or with a minor.
